children: Solv Protocol is scheduled to unlock 159.32 million SOLV in March 2027. The release covers tokens allocated to investors, the project team, and ecosystem wallets. The amount to be unlocked equals 2.70% of the circulating supply.
When the lock expires, investors and team members will have more SOLV available to sell. Their unlocked holdings add to the token's potential sell supply.

title: Solv Protocol: Unlocks 159.32 Million SOLV - Mar 2027
